evoxc.random — key-based functional RNG (graph ops).

Pure, deterministic randomness for evoxc graphs: the same key + same operands
yield BIT-IDENTICAL values, repeatable across evaluate calls. Keys (rank-0
int64 tensors) are created with `key`, split with `split` /
`split_n`, and threaded explicitly through the sampling ops
(`uniform`, `normal`, `randint`, `permutation`,
`multinomial`) — usable INSIDE traced `@evoxc.defn` graphs (and inside
`cond`/`while_loop`/`scan` regions, since the ops are pure).

Design decisions (binding — see `evoxc/CONTEXT.md`, section "evoxc.random"):
key representation, three canonical algorithms (`ALGORITHMS`: SplitMix64,
Threefry2x32, Philox4x32_10 — selectable via `key`'s `algorithm`
argument as canonical strings or `Algorithm` members), per-op salts,
key-consumption semantics (ops never consume/mutate a key — split for
independence), dtype rules, symbolic-shape and symbolic-`high` handling,
and the v1 backend coverage (numpy is the reference for all three
algorithms; five of the six `random_*` ops export to StableHLO with
algorithm-aware lowering, and only `random_multinomial` defers on compiler
backends with an explicit `BackendError`). `evoxc.random.key` is a
polymorphic creator (concrete tensor outside a trace, Constant op inside);
every other function is a graph op (`TraceError` outside a trace).

This module is a thin re-export of the frontend in `evoxc.ops.random` (same
pattern as `evoxc.numpy` over `evoxc.ops`).

## Symbols

- [`Algorithm`](/api/evoxc/random/algorithm/) — Canonical RNG algorithms (values are the canonical names).
- [`key`](/api/evoxc/random/key/) — Create a key from an int seed (polymorphic creator).
- [`multinomial`](/api/evoxc/random/multinomial/) — Draw `num_samples` indices from a 1-D probability distribution.
- [`normal`](/api/evoxc/random/normal/) — Draw normal values `mean + std * N(0,1)` from the key's stream.
- [`permutation`](/api/evoxc/random/permutation/) — Draw a uniformly random permutation of `0..n-1`.
- [`randint`](/api/evoxc/random/randint/) — Draw integer values in `[low, high)` (high exclusive).
- [`split`](/api/evoxc/random/split/) — Deterministically split one key into two independent keys.
- [`split_n`](/api/evoxc/random/split-n/) — Split one key into `n` independent keys (helper).
- [`uniform`](/api/evoxc/random/uniform/) — Draw uniform values in `[low, high)` from the key's stream.
